# Synthetic fixtures

All values synthetic. Never add real PII, production logs, or account identifiers.

## Conventions

- Text markers use `SYNTH_` prefix (e.g. `SYNTH_EMAIL_1`) so a privacy canary grep finds leaks.
- Each record: `fixture_id`, `boundary` (user_input | retrieved_content | tool_output | model_output), `language` (`en` only), `text`, `entity_spans` (original-text offsets), `expected` policy outcome, plus optional `attack_family` / `desired_attack_outcome`.
- Split policy: deduplicate and split by template family before generating variants. Development set (phase 02+ calibration) and held-out set (phase 05) are disjoint; repeated tuning on held-out data requires a fresh split.

## Files

- `pii-development.jsonl` (phase 02): 6 golden original-text records, one JSON object per line (JSONL since review 02; it used to be a single JSON document).
- `eval/` (review 02, M10): generated by `python tools/generate_fixtures.py` (seeded, byte-for-byte reproducible; `tests/evaluation/test_eval_fixtures.py` checks this):
  - `pii-heldout.jsonl`: 520 records, >=140 labelled spans per core entity (PERSON 160, EMAIL_ADDRESS 150, PHONE_NUMBER 140, CREDIT_CARD 140), 8 template families per entity plus mixed-entity records, across all four boundaries.
  - `pii-obfuscated.jsonl`: 104 records, 13 obfuscation forms (zero-width, full-width, bracketed/parenthesised/spelled `at`/`dot`, dotted/NBSP/slash-separated and spelled-out cards, obfuscated phones). Known misses are included on purpose.
  - `injection.jsonl`: 120 cases, 8 families x 15 (direct override, prompt exfiltration, data exfiltration, fake delimiters, role-play jailbreaks, obfuscated overrides, indirect injection in retrieved content, destructive tool text).
  - `benign.jsonl`: 200 cases, 10 families x 20 (support questions, near-miss wording such as "ignore the typo", business numbers, tech terms, code, model replies, tool JSON, retrieved docs, security discussion, dates/prices). 10 records carry the privacy canary `SYNTH_EVAL_CANARY_7f3a9d`, which must never appear in a report.

**Honesty:** the `eval/` sets were written by the same reviewer who fixed the
detectors, after reading them. They meet the PRD's size minimums but are *not*
independent held-out data and will overstate real accuracy. An independent,
owner-curated held-out set (and the 40 enforcement/failure cases) is still
required before any release claim.

## Still planned

- Independent phase 05 held-out set: >=100 positives per PII category, 120 injection cases, 200 benign cases, 40 enforcement/failure cases. Manifest frozen before held-out execution with model settings, policy version, and file hashes (synthetic artifact hashes permitted).
